title: [29x]-Bug 658773: Mileage: starting/ending point addresses over 50 characters fail to save on report lines (BC Text[50] limit not enforced)
summary: Fixes mileage starting and ending point addresses longer than 50 characters failing to save on expense report lines, where the Text[50] limit was not enforced. The Expense, Expense Report Line and Posted Expense Report Line tables were changed.
key_points: Addresses over 50 characters previously failed to save because the Text[50] limit was not enforced
Changes made to the Expense, Expense Report Line and Posted Expense Report Line tables
